theme_strategy.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Refined for Finance)

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Key metrics
headings.install_command: Already available via Google Fonts or standard web fonts

body.notes: Use tabular-nums class for all financial data to ensure alignment

numbers.usage: Ledger entries, sensitive data, currency displays
numbers.notes: Optional: Use Inter with tabular-nums if monospace is too aggressive

rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds. Use #09090b (Zinc 950).
Text over images must have a subtle text-shadow or bg-gradient overlay.
Financial positives are Green (Emerald-500), negatives are Red (Rose-500).
Interactive elements must have clear hover states (brightness-110 or bg-white/5).

spacing_and_layout.mobile_strategy: Stack vertically, use Bottom Sheets (Drawers) for complex actions

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md font-medium shadow-lg shadow-primary/20

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900/50 border-zinc-800 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md h-10

charts.style: Minimalist, hide grid lines if possible, use custom tooltips with glassmorphism

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px, consistent sizing (w-4 h-4 for small, w-5 h-5 for distinct)

login_background.usage: Cover image for Login/Register split screen

images.fallback_patterns: Use CSS radial gradients (e.g., radial-gradient(circle at top right, #10b98110, transparent)) for empty states or headers.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle glows only. No full-screen gradients. Use 'spotlight' effects for headers.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Data density is key for dashboards. Don't waste space, but keep it legible.
Animation: Use framer-motion for page transitions and list entry (staggered).
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratio > 4.5:1. Use ARIA labels on icon buttons.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly (0.98) on click.
Currency formatting: Always use 'R$' and correct locale 'pt-BR'.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup the global theme in index.css (define CSS variables for colors).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Create the 'Layout' component that handles the responsive shell (Sidebar/BottomNav).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Implement the Dashboard using the Bento Grid strategy.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all text is in Portuguese (BR).
